lcc_original: 我呢，你看罷，我要使洪流大水臨到地上，來毀滅天下凡有血肉的，就是有生氣的活物：凡在地上的都必溺死。
notes: LCC inverts the UNV opening order: UNV '看哪<WH02009>，我<WH0589>' → LCC '我<WH0589>呢，你看罷<WH02009>'. H589 attaches to the first 我 (discourse subject 我呢); 呢 is a Chinese particle with no Hebrew equivalent. H2009 attaches to 你看罷 (the hinneh exclamation).

LCC '來毀滅' splits UNV '毀滅<WAH09001><WH07843><WTH8763>': the lamed purpose-marker WAH09001 (לְ = 'in order to') attaches to 來 (the Chinese purpose marker), while the core verb WH07843 + morphology WTH8763 attach to 毀滅.

LCC has two 凡 corresponding to Hebrew's two כֹּל. UNV provides only one WAH03605, placed on 凡地上 = כֹּל אֲשֶׁר-בָּאָרֶץ (all that is on the earth). Accordingly, WAH03605 is assigned to the second LCC 凡 (凡在地上的都必溺死); the first LCC 凡 (天下凡有血肉的 = כָּל-בָּשָׂר) is left untagged because UNV does not supply a separate WAH03605 token for it.
UNV's implicit {<WAH0834>} (asher, relative pronoun) becomes explicit 的<WAH0834> in both relative clauses of LCC (有血肉的, 有生氣的): braces dropped per rule 3 since 的 is an explicit word.

UNV's implicit {<WAH09002>} (bet-prefix, 'in/with') becomes explicit 有<WAH09002> in '就是有生氣的' (LCC uses 有 to express 'having/in') and explicit 在<WAH09002> in '在地上' (LCC uses 在 to express the preposition ב): braces dropped per rule 3 in both cases.
LCC '臨到' absorbs UNV '氾濫在<WAH05921>' — WAH05921 (עַל, 'upon/over') attaches to 臨到 since it carries the directional-prepositional sense of the Hebrew.
LCC '溺死' (drown and die) paraphrases UNV '死' as the rendering of H01478 (גָּוַע, expire/perish); WH01478 + WTH8799 attach to 溺死.
